title: Graph-Structured Rubrics: Compiling Rubrics into Typed Evaluation Graphs for LLM Judges
abstract: arXiv:2608.12097v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based evaluators commonly treat rubrics as prompt context or flat criteria: they specify what to judge but leave criterion composition implicit, even when natural-language rules state it. We introduce Graph-Structured Rubrics (GSR), which compiles a rubric into a response-independent typed evaluation graph before observing responses. Criterion nodes elicit judgments; transformation, reduction, and gating operators compose them through named ports; and a task-specific output mapping, termed Readout, converts the unique sink into a score or preference. Compilation rejects malformed or type-incompatible graphs. Pointwise evaluation judges rubric dimensions separately before graph aggregation; pairwise evaluation reuses the graph with one judgment for each candidate under every criterion. translated_title: 图结构化评分标准：将评分标准编译为用于LLM评审者的类型化评估图
translated_abstract: 基于评分标准的评估器通常将评分标准视为提示上下文或平面标准：它们指定了要评判的内容，但未明确标准组合方式，即使自然语言规则中已说明。我们引入了图结构化评分标准（GSR），它在观察响应之前将评分标准编译为响应无关的类型化评估图。标准节点引出评判；转换、归约和门控运算符通过命名端口组合这些评判；任务特定的输出映射（称为Readout）将唯一汇节点转换为分数或偏好。编译会拒绝格式错误或类型不兼容的图。逐点评估在图形聚合之前分别评判各评分维度；成对评估则重用该图，对每个候选者在每个标准下进行一次评判。在GPT-OSS-120B下，GSR在四个逐点数据集上的精确分数一致性比Prometheus风格评分提高了0.62至6.75个百分点。
tldr: 本文提出图结构化评分标准（GSR），通过将评分标准编译为类型化评估图，明确标准组合方式，显著提升LLM评审者的评分一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Graph-Structured Rubrics (GSR), which compiles rubrics into typed evaluation graphs to explicitly define criterion composition, notably improving score agreement for LLM judges.
